name: gitv
description: See your .git — every byte, every object, live. A git repository visualizer that parses real bytes and animates history as it happens.

scripts.compile: bun run scripts/embed.ts && bun build --compile src/cli.ts --outfile dist/gitv && bun -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('src/embedded-app.ts',{force:true})"
